skills.description: Founder Signal turns verified Reddit and V2EX evidence into a small, reviewable signal package for founders evaluating product demand and positioning across one or more configured product profiles. Use this skill when the user wants founder research from Reddit or V2EX evidence, a scored review artifact, or a Draft page generated from any run outcome. This skill depends on the canonical draft-cli skill. Draft is the default founder review surface, so Founder Signal emits a Draft-ready public publish intent for every run, regardless of success or failure.
